theorems.name: Submission.dimred_cs_sos_mt_cc_product_support
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k m' n' : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclid P)) (A : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m') (RA : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m') (B : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n') (RB : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n'), IsCompact E → IsCompact A.support → RA.Represents A → RB.Represents B → (∀ C : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet C → RB.measure C = ∫⁻ t in E, RA.measure ((fun y => t + y) ⁻¹' C) ∂μHE[k]) → B.support ⊆ Set.image2 (fun t y => t + y) E A.support
